get_predict_unit: get a pretrained MLIP prediction unit for a specified model name with default or turbo inference settings
get_reference_energies: get atomic or form elemental reference energies for a pretrained model from HuggingFace Hub
pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name: download and return the local checkpoint file path for a pretrained model by name
available_models: list all available pretrained model names from the fairchem HuggingFace checkpoint registry
HuggingFaceCheckpoint: review the HuggingFaceCheckpoint dataclass that stores filename, repo_id, subfolder, revision, and reference energy fields
